output_dir.description: Output directory for the prepared supermin appliance

packages.description: List of packages to include in the appliance. Dependencies are resolved automatically. Items: string - package name.

packager_config.description: Path to the package manager configuration file (yum.conf, pacman.conf, etc.). Empty string disables.

use_installed.description: If true, use locally installed packages instead of downloading

build_format.description: Output format for the built appliance: 'chroot' or 'ext2'

build_output_dir.description: Output directory for the final built appliance. If empty, uses output_dir.

ext2_size.description: Size of the ext2 filesystem image (e.g., '4G', '10G'). Only applies when build_format is 'ext2'

kernel_path.description: Path to a custom kernel image. If empty, supermin auto-selects the host kernel via SUPERMIN_KERNEL.

modules_path.description: Path to the kernel modules directory. If empty, supermin auto-selects the host modules via SUPERMIN_MODULES.

host_files.description: List of host file paths to include in the appliance. Wildcards allowed. Items: string - file path.

exclude_patterns.description: List of patterns to exclude from the final appliance. Items: string - exclusion pattern.

verbose.description: If true, enable verbose output (-v flag)
